root_draft.speaker: agent
root_draft.text: LanternDeeps takes an expedition below the cold nightside into a persistent, wondrous cavern where mineral wealth turns out to be living company. Blue lanternstone and fungal pastures light galleries full of alien life, valuable stone and the excellent equipment of people who never came back. Your lamps make work possible and advertise your presence; living Lantern crystals offer safe light, at the cost of leaving their harvest standing. Crystal crust grows toward sleepers, fragments fight and multiply, and a roof gives dust and a grumble before it falls. Among the remains, dead machines stand near aware crystals and turn toward the light. Orun-Ghal, a skeleton still inside its walking mining suit, can be studied and befriended over repeated visits; it is an inhabitant, never a miner or a boss. The discovery should change how you regard what you came to extract: the riches and the haunted technology are alive and intelligent. The free mod supplies the cavern and its inhabitants; campaign companions add their particular rare minerals and mindstone uses. Returning means returning to the same place, carrying the consequences of what you did there.

asks.text: At which moment does this become the Lantern Deeps you meant, and which part of my root gives the wrong impression?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F2. Your experience sentence already sets wonder, wealth and intelligence. The unresolved point is how that turn should organise the promise, rather than whether those ingredients belong.
asks.guessed_answer: Recognition is the turn; wealth makes the first visit tempting and wonder makes the discovery worth returning to. I would keep that order.
asks.tree_effects: If recognition leads, the root ties the expedition to a visible response from an inhabitant. If wonder leads, the root leads with the cavern encounter and makes recognition its later payoff. If the extraction dilemma leads, the root centres on the choice made after discovery. All built capabilities retain coverage under every answer. Corrections rewrite dependent claims; silence approves nothing.

asks.text: Which scene should come first when you judge whether this mod understood you, and what one failure there would make you stop the demonstration?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F2/F3. No flagship pick was found. A spectacular explosion could overshadow the intelligence reveal; a gallery full of still objects could conceal the dangerous ecology.
asks.guessed_answer: A, because it puts the words “haunted technology” on screen through an action. I recommend the mining scene separately, so danger has its own proof.
asks.tree_effects: His recorded pick becomes showcase 1, with the stated rejection as a candidate acceptance requirement. B or C first changes the order and fixture, not the coverage owed to the other capabilities. Root approval alone is not a showcase pick; later showcases must add substantially different play.

asks.text: What should the inhabitants do in that moment that would make you feel you are dealing with intelligence, rather than animals attracted to a lamp?
asks.decision: Intelligence revealed through reaction to extraction
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F2. The root's reveal could otherwise be supplied entirely by a letter. Your existing ruling settles Orun-Ghal's role; it does not settle a response to somebody else extracting the rock.
asks.guessed_answer: A recognisable response from the keeper or suit, giving the player a chance to understand its concern before proceeding. I would first explore an observed reaction, without inventing a combat or ownership system.
asks.tree_effects: If observation and study suffice, add no mining-permission system; prove the response and its meaning through the gallery scene. If an objection must alter mining, define the particular act, readable objection and way to make amends. If the crystals distinguish ordinary rock from a living mind, bind that distinction rather than making every rock sentient. No answer turns Orun-Ghal into a worker or boss.

asks.text: Before that first attack, what should the expedition notice, and what should it still have time to do?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F3. Accumulating exposure is built, as is the Lantern exception. The desired warning and reaction opportunity are not established by a private exposure number or a successful spawn.
asks.guessed_answer: Something approaching through the dark, enough notice to stop exposed work and regroup, with no exact countdown. I recommend making the approach readable before adding a numerical meter.
asks.tree_effects: An approaching resident needs a real approach path and observable response to light. A readable emergence needs a warning, a valid arrival space and time to react. If the first attack itself is the intended notice, record that boundary and require an understandable cause afterward. The safe-light comparison remains under every answer; its rule is not up for approval again.

asks.text: When you choose to harvest that Lantern, what should you feel you have gained, and what should make you hesitate?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F2. “Light now versus light later, sold” is already the design. Ordinary harvest yields and growth times may make it an inconsequential crop or an exhausting wait; the intended weight of the decision is still unclear.
asks.guessed_answer: A worthwhile haul bought by making tomorrow's work less safe, with replanting a practical commitment. I would tune the reward and recovery around a working camp, not around a laboratory harvest.
asks.tree_effects: A valuable one-off haul needs a meaningful recovery interval and an extraction scene. A cultivated supply needs a repeated harvest/replant scene showing the light gap still matters. A choice mainly about where to work needs route and work-area coverage. If obtaining the first safe light is itself the journey, make that a separate first-use scene; no natural placement is silently promised.

asks.text: What would Orun-Ghal do differently on this return that would make “befriended” feel true to you?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F2. The study and friendship capability is built. An increasing number and a congratulatory letter could satisfy its current proof without delivering a relationship.
asks.guessed_answer: It recognises the visitors and deliberately comes to meet or accompany them for a while. I would begin with a clear change in its rounds, within its established non-worker role.
asks.tree_effects: Recognition through movement needs early/late visits compared through the real job, including departure and reload. Recognition through a response or communication needs that specific response. If its existing approach and inspect text suffice, bind those rather than inventing gifts or services. Any proposed practical favour needs a separate boundary; mining and boss behaviour remain excluded.

asks.text: Which rescue or preparation should a careful crew be able to finish during an ordinary roof warning, and which mistake should still cost them?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F3. The default warning is fifteen seconds at normal speed, but neither that number nor a delayed roof proves useful warning. Ordinary unsupported roofs and blast-forced roofs need honest, different expectations.
asks.guessed_answer: Enough time to withdraw nearby workers or finish a prepared prop, not to build a support network from scratch. A knocker should turn a close escape into a manageable one.
asks.tree_effects: Withdrawal needs a timed path with workers at actual work positions. A prop-building window needs materials, labour and a supported/unsupported comparison. A rescue window needs a downed pawn and a real carry job. If those are all too generous, define the smaller intended response explicitly. Blast-forced collapse stays separately demonstrated; a prop is not falsely advertised as saving it.

asks.text: At that stage, which recurring decision should still make this feel like living among the Deep's ecology, and which part of the day should finally feel secure?
asks.decision: Settled routine versus remaining ecological decisions
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F3. The code supplies several pressures, but their combined experience could become constant maintenance or disappear once the first camp is built.
asks.guessed_answer: Prepared rooms and sleep should become dependable; expansion, exposed work and transporting valuable harvests should still demand attention. I recommend a settled-day scene followed by one deliberate expansion.
asks.tree_effects: If managed coexistence leads, prove that the prepared routine works while expansion exposes a specific remaining risk. If repeated expeditions lead, prove the preparation, haul and return cycle. If a permanent camp should remain under active pressure, name the particular decision and recovery rather than accepting arbitrary interruptions. Every built animal keeps its own acceptance coverage; this is an additional interaction scene.

asks.text: What encounter with something enormous would belong down here, and what should the crew be able to do when it comes near?
asks.author: Codex Designer dry run, 2026-11-10
asks.picture_kind: written thought experiment; no capture, staged scene or visual mock
asks.why_it_matters: F1/F3. `LANTERNDEEPS_TITAN_POPULATE_DIM_AND_SMALL` is an existing unresolved content decision, not evidence that Galuush is missing. A small persistent cave cannot simply inherit a surface titan route without an intelligible way in and out.
asks.guessed_answer: A giant already living in a deeper void, whose approach makes the crew yield space rather than defend a doorway. I would explore its route and scale before naming a species.
asks.tree_effects: A resident passage requires a new chosen creature, traversable cavern geometry, approach warning and an honest route. A visiting giant requires its origin, entry and exit to make sense. A distant encounter requires observable consequences without pretending it entered the playable gallery. A newly stated deferral records this item as later; it does not remove the built galuush or other fauna. No creature or route is selected by this guess.

contradictions.text: October empty free tier/crystal life unbuilt assertions are historical. Current code owns active fauna, Lantern, Creep/Cleavers, Shard-minds/Working Dead and Orun-Ghal; those are inventoried as present.

validation.py:425 still requires five older ports; local wildAnimals currently contains only gembug and drinker from that family. Soulchime, grub and megapleura defs remain dormant. Cause/authority for those absent rows not recovered; do not delete or restore based on this discrepancy.

Sipper/aurora writes share named multipliers through LightLedger; no duplicate radius owner proposed. Safe-Lantern provenance instead uses radius-only proximity, and excludes terrain/sky; actual blocked-light/mixed-light acceptance absent.

Answering is removed/later despite old built item. Gallery and matrix/head recipes do exist in companion. End-to-end Kindled route, wipe immunity and first making remain unverified here; do not call them wholly unbuilt from stale prose.
Storm mirror scans world/other maps, not source map only; local independent timer also exists. Collapse hook proves a warning hold, not unsupported fall or prop recovery.

Draft lore says minds welcome colonists and dislike mining. No reaction/permission system for colony mining implemented. Source identifies the lore as draft, so its moral conclusion is not stored as owner intent.
Safe Lantern is sowable but unlisted in local wildPlants/scatter. Cross-src XML reference search found no explicit natural placement of RM_Lantern. No immediate natural safe-light oasis promised.

failure_modes: F1 — A pretty resource room replaces a living cavern: light management, the fungal pasture and the consequences of extraction do not form understandable choices. Sources: design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md:16; src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Source/MapComponent_LanternDeepDarkness.cs.

F2 — Intelligence exists only in labels and letters: the dead do not visibly answer the crystals, friendship does not change an encounter, or the reveal fails to change how the player regards the riches. Sources: design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md:16; src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Source/RM_WorkingDead.cs; src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Source/RM_OrunGhal.cs.

F3 — The expedition cannot trust the place: warnings buy no useful action, overlapping light or heat effects lie, return trips lose their consequences, or a proof shortcut is mistaken for the player's experience. Sources: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_lantern_deeps.md; src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Source/RM_AuroraCollapse.cs; src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Source/RM_DeepHarness.cs.

neighbours.text: MapPortal/CaveExit persistence/sealing, animal jobs, roofs, invisibility, heat and corpse rules already exist; use these before duplicating engines. All expansions assumed.
Hard dependency owns fluid sacs/poison, psychic stun/soothe/armor, wound links, kin healing, breeding/caps; LanternDeeps supplies def wiring.
Linked production source; modifiers compose across assemblies, settings renderer and patch failure support shared. Safe-light classification is still local.
Mindstone gallery, crystal scatters/gates, matrix/head recipes and final Kindled route. They do not make franchise content a free-mod requirement.
Owns wreck generator/density/hull and rig defs; this biome opts in by extraGenSteps. Standalone load without it not verified.
Opt-in payload only, guarded by FindMod; scanner owns actual detection.
Global abundance and deep-drill home policy can supersede/restrict the local substitution. No new rival mineral registry proposed.
Optional rare resource scatter, vanilla scatter engine. Own mod/donor name guards already built.
Passage engine belongs to HugeThings; biome owes candidate/visitor and route story. Galuush is a separate stationary landmark, not a replacement for passage selection.
Campaign-wide cargo movement repurposed from original sitting. Deep mouth is an integration site; this mod does not own a second cargo system.
